description: Our team brings together backend, frontend, mobile, and AI development skills, which allows us to turn ideas into complete working solutions. We enjoy hackathons, experimenting with new technologies, and building creative solutions under pressure.
summary: Martian Map is an interactive atlas for exploring Mars and planning research traverses. It combines a global map and shaded relief with six measured HiRISE terrain models. Users can explore a site in 3D, screen for steep or rough terrain, and plan routes around hazards and gaps in coverage. The atlas also links Jezero stops to mapped geologic units and provides historical Curiosity radiation readings for Gale Crater. By bringing imagery, elevation, geology, and route estimates together, the prototype helps users compare sites and understand the evidence behind a planning decision.
details:
Martian Map connects a searchable global atlas to local terrain and route planning. The atlas combines NASA Mars Trek orbital imagery and shaded relief with 18 official landmarks. Users can explore measured HiRISE terrain at Jezero Crater, Gale Crater, Eberswalde Crater, Victoria Crater, Columbia Hills, and East Melas Chasma in 2D and 3D.

Each local view uses a measured elevation model and its matching RED orthophoto. The planner calculates slope and roughness, keeps unmeasured terrain visible and blocked, and computes routes across surveyed areas. Wider regional estimates use coarser MOLA elevation data. Jezero science stops follow mapped USGS geologic units. Gale includes historical Curiosity radiation readings from January 2020 as site context, and users can explore four Curiosity sites from a rover perspective using NASA/JPL Access Mars reconstructions.

We built the browser app with TypeScript, Vite, Leaflet, Three.js, and 3d-tiles-renderer. The prototype helps users compare candidate routes and inspect the measurements behind each estimate. Coverage varies by site, and local hazard thresholds are adjustable for demonstration. Safe astronaut travel would require additional data and validation.
